title: The Last Protocol
author: V. M. Thackeray
blurb: Orsen Thackeray, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
